description: Stores a podziemie.dashboard/1 document as a private draft for 24 hours and returns its link. Not listed anywhere; whoever opens the link can read it, and the person signs in there to save it to their dashboards (Polish UI: raporty). A document that fails the checks is not stored, and each problem comes back with its JSON pointer.

dashboard.description: A podziemie.dashboard/1 document as JSON text: {"$schema":"podziemie.dashboard/1","title":…,"tiles":[…]}, the shape of podziemie_get_dashboard's `dashboard` (chart, number and text tiles).

name: podziemie_draft_dashboard
title: Draft dashboard
